recipes.name: Best Thanksgiving Gravy On a Budget
ingredients: 2.5 cups store-bought or homemade turkey stock (See recipe)
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
Chopped fresh herbs, such as fresh thyme or sage (optional)
instructions: In a medium saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the flour and whisk to combine, to create a roux. Cook for 30 seconds to toast the flour.
Slowly pour in the turkey stock, whisking to incorporate the stock into the roux until the stock begins to thicken into a gravy.
Season with salt and pepper, to taste. Add the herbs, if using, and stir to incorporate.
